summary: Iteration 1 tested the backend and the frontend. Backend: 26/26 pytest pass after 2 fixes by the tester. Fix 1: the regex in the q search param was unescaped, so a search for '(' returned 500. Fix 2: PUT /api/cart/items with quantity 0 returned 422. The main frontend flows pass in the Expo web preview at 390x844: home, product detail with toast, Beli Sekarang, cart +/-/remove, checkout validation, mock payment, order-success, orders, Kategori sidebar, category sort chips, search with an empty state, guest wishlist from the card heart, the product-detail heart and the wishlist screen, login (wrong-password error, demo login, still logged in after reload, logout) and register (short-password validation, then success). A critical crash existed before the tester's backend fix: tapping '-' at qty 1 in Keranjang sent quantity 0, the backend returned 422, and the Expo 'Uncaught Error [object Object]' overlay appeared. The frontend still has no error handling for this. No deprecated Expo packages detected (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner or expo-background-fetch).

critical.issue: Before the tester's fix: CartItemIn.quantity had ge=1, so quantity 0 returned 422 and the '<=0 -> remove' branch could never run. The frontend's '-' at qty 1 sends 0 and crashed the app. The tester added a CartQtyIn model (ge=0) for PUT.

minor.issue: Before the tester's fix: the regex was unescaped, so q='(' returned 500. The tester changed it to re.escape(q).
Quantity is not checked against product stock. POST adds quantity without a cap. PUT also adds unknown product_ids to the cart without checking that the product exists.
Does not check that the product exists.
CheckoutIn fields have no min_length, so the API accepts empty full_name, phone, address and city. Stock is not reduced after an order.
An invalid or expired Bearer token silently falls back to the guest identity and does not return 401.
The guest cart and wishlist (X-Guest-Id) are not merged into the user's cart and wishlist on login or register. Items added as a guest disappear after login.

ui_bugs.issue: cart-context updateQty, removeItem, addToCart and toggleWishlist have no try/catch, so any API error becomes an unhandled rejection and the red Uncaught Error overlay. Fixed on the backend side for qty=0, but there is still no frontend error handling.
When FastAPI 422 'detail' is an array, it is thrown as 'Error([object Object])'. Stringify it or map it to a friendly message. Reference: /app/frontend/src/api.ts:69

ui_bugs.component: Product detail with an invalid id
ui_bugs.issue: /product/does-not-exist shows an endless spinner with no error message and no back button. Loading is set to false, but the render still checks '!product'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/product/[id].tsx:48

The sidebar ScrollView (style width 110) renders about 250px wide on web because RN-web ScrollView has flexGrow 1 by default. The product area gets squeezed into one narrow column. Add flexGrow:0 and flexShrink:0 to the sidebar. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/kategori.tsx:104
The p-ac-01 'AC 1 PK Low Watt Inverter' image (unsplash photo-1631545308456-d56e71c7a0a7) does not load and shows a grey blank box. Reference: /app/backend/server.py:90

integration_issues.issue: login.tsx and register.tsx call router.replace('/(tabs)/akun') after being pushed from the Akun tab. This stacks a second (tabs) navigator, which is why there are 2 profile-card elements in the DOM. Use router.back() or dismiss instead.
The guest cart is lost after login because there is no merge.

issues: Touch targets are under 44px: card heart is 28x28, qty-plus and qty-minus are 32x32, back-btn and pd-wishlist-btn are 36x36. hitSlop helps on native only.
Beli Sekarang adds the selected qty again even if the user already tapped Keranjang (2+2=4). Consider going to the cart without adding a duplicate, or setting the quantity.
Card widths use the module-level Dimensions.get('window'), so they do not update on rotation, resize or web. Use useWindowDimensions.

action_items: Add try/catch and user-facing error toasts in cart-context (addToCart, updateQty, removeItem, toggleWishlist) and on product detail.
Make api.ts handle an array 'detail' (422) and turn it into a readable message.
Add a not-found/error state with a back button to product/[id].tsx when the fetch fails.
Fix the Kategori sidebar width on web (flexGrow:0 and flexShrink:0 on the sidebar ScrollView).
Replace router.replace('/(tabs)/akun') in login.tsx and register.tsx with router.back() or dismiss to avoid duplicate tab stacks.
Merge the guest cart and wishlist into the user's on login and register (backend, using the X-Guest-Id header).
Validate checkout fields (min_length) and cart quantity against stock on the backend.
Replace the broken p-ac-01 image URL.
Increase touch targets to 44px or more (heart, qty buttons, header icons).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: PUT handler logic expected quantity <= 0 but the model forbade it (fixed with CartQtyIn).
server.py: user input was put into the Mongo $regex unescaped (fixed with re.escape).
get_owner: an invalid token silently becomes a guest. Return 401 for a bad Bearer token.
Dimensions.get at module scope is used in 6 screens.
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py (import re, re.escape in the products q filter, new CartQtyIn model for the PUT cart item endpoint)

success_rate.frontend: ~90%. All core flows pass. The qty-minus crash was fixed through the backend. The remaining issues are UX and robustness.

seed_data_creation: No seed data created. These tests created data: TEST_ guest carts and orders, users test_*@example.com (API) and test_ui_51957@example.com (UI), plus orders for those users. They were not deleted because there is no delete endpoint.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: export EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env, then pytest /app/backend/tests/test_pgs_api.py (pytest.ini uses xdist; the fixtures are module-scoped per worker). The Expo stack keeps earlier screens in the DOM, so use '>> visible=true' selectors (for example, profile-card appears twice). Bottom tab testIDs: tab-home, tab-kategori, tab-keranjang, tab-akun. The home search opener is 'search-input-open', not 'header-search'.
rca_of_issue: Keranjang crash: keranjang.tsx:52 calls updateQty(id, max(0, qty-1)), which sends PUT quantity=0. Backend CartItemIn(quantity ge=1) returned 422 with detail as an array. In api.ts:69, new Error(detail) became '[object Object]'. There is no catch in cart-context.updateQty or in onPress, so the error was unhandled and Expo showed the Uncaught Error overlay. Mitigation: a backend PUT model allowing ge=0 (done). Still needed: frontend catch plus a toast.
